about: 680 · every frame the SDK handed BroBot's Claude adapter for one conversation on claude-opus-5-5[1m], taken by packages/runtime/smoke/model-floor-refusal-probe.smoke.ts on 2026-09-24 through the product's own ClaudeRuntime. At SDK 0.3.218 (CLI 2.1.218) the server refuses the model below its version floor; the same session moved to claude-opus-5[1m] answers; a model id no server serves is refused as model_not_found. At SDK 0.3.281 (CLI 2.1.281) the floor answers and the unknown id is still refused. The 0.3.218 refusal cannot be produced again once the pin is past the floor. Frames are verbatim except three path kinds replaced by <cwd>, <providerHome> and <socket>.
